name: At random
summary: This EA opens trades at random without any technical analysis or strategy-based entry signals. It randomly selects a direction (buy or sell) and places market orders with configurable lot size, stop loss, and take profit levels, operating purely on chance rather than market conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA在没有任何技术分析或策略信号的情况下随机开仓交易。它随机选择方向（买入或卖出），以可配置的手数、止损和止盈水平下市价单，完全基于概率而非市场条件进行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是完全随机入场，不依赖任何技术指标或市场分析。入场条件是通过随机数生成器决定买入或卖出方向，没有任何趋势、动量或形态判断。出场条件依赖设定的固定止损和止盈值，没有移动止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数，没有根据账户余额或风险比例进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏保护机制，没有最大回撤限制、最大持仓限制或连续亏损后的保护措施。整体而言，这是一个纯概率驱动的交易系统，缺乏任何可重复的统计优势。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is purely random entry, relying on no technical indicators or market analysis whatsoever. Entry conditions are determined by a random number generator to decide buy or sell direction, with no trend, momentum, or pattern assessment. Exit conditions depend on fixed stop loss and take profit values set by the user, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management lacks protective mechanisms, with no maximum drawdown limit, maximum position limit, or protection after consecutive losses. Overall, this is a probability-driven trading system with no repeatable statistical edge.
pros: 代码结构简单易懂，适合初学者学习EA基本框架
有止损和止盈设置，提供基本的风险控制
随机入场可以作为基准测试，用来对比其他策略的有效性
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand code structure, suitable for beginners learning EA framework basics
Has stop loss and take profit settings providing basic risk control
Random entry can serve as a benchmark test to compare effectiveness of other strategies
cons: 没有任何分析逻辑，纯粹赌博式交易，长期必然亏损
缺乏动态仓位管理和资金管理机制，无法适应不同账户规模
没有交易频率控制，可能在短时间内频繁开仓导致过度交易
缺少最大回撤保护和连续亏损保护机制
不检查点差和交易成本，可能在高点差环境下频繁亏损
cons_en: No analytical logic whatsoever, purely gambling-style trading that will inevitably lose money long-term
Lacks dynamic position sizing and money management mechanisms, unable to adapt to different account sizes
No trade frequency control, may open positions too frequently in short periods leading to overtrading
Missing maximum drawdown protection and consecutive loss protection mechanisms
Does not check spread and trading costs, may incur frequent losses in high-spread environments
improvements: 添加交易频率限制，例如每个K线只允许开仓一次，避免过度交易
加入账户资金保护机制，如最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的暂停交易功能
improvements_en: Add trade frequency limits, such as allowing only one trade per bar, to avoid overtrading
Implement account equity protection mechanisms, such as maximum drawdown limits and pause-trading functionality after consecutive losses

risk_points: 纯随机交易无任何统计优势，长期必然亏损
没有交易频率控制可能导致短时间内大量开仓
没有最大回撤保护和资金管理机制
risk_points_en: Pure random trading has no statistical edge, will inevitably lose money long-term
No trade frequency control may lead to massive position opening in short time
No maximum drawdown protection or money management mechanism

summary_en: This EA opens trades at random without any technical analysis or strategy-based entry signals. It randomly selects a direction (buy or sell) and places market orders with configurable lot size, stop loss, and take profit levels, operating purely on chance rather than market conditions.
